name: Belvedere
notes: Redirects to /ausstellungen-aktuell; only 8 exhibitions listed (2 permanent 'Dauerausstellung' + 6 temporary), no pagination. ld+json on the page only lists titles/links, no dates, so parsed server HTML teaser cards instead (title, category, venue, <time datetime> pair, detail link).
